conclusion: Strong augmentation improved both field metrics on average, but the paired improvements were not consistent across all three seeds.
field_error_summary: Ordinary training most often predicted late blight, assigning that label to 540.0 of 742 field images on average (SD 85.8); its true support was 111.
Strong training most often predicted late blight, assigning that label to 543.7 of 742 field images on average (SD 56.3); its true support was 111.
The largest signed mean class-recall change was +10.7 pp for septoria, and the smallest was -8.3 pp for early blight.
